findings.correction: Jopil nodded at his subordinate’s report. The man’s martial arts were only Third Rate, but his tracking skills were Peak. Jopil had countless hunting dogs like that under his command.
findings.current: Jopil nodded at his subordinate’s report. His martial arts were only Third Rate, but his tracking skills were Peak. He had countless hunting dogs like this under his command.
findings.defect: After Jopil nods, “His” reads as Jopil. The Third Rate martial arts and Peak tracking describe the reporting subordinate, one of many such hunting dogs under Peak-master Jopil.
findings.rationale: 조필 is already established as a Peak master. 무공은 삼류지만 추종술은 절정이다 characterizes the tracker who just reported; 이런 사냥개들 points at men of that type, not at Jopil.
findings.source: 수하의 보고에 조필이 고개를 끄덕였다. 무공은 삼류지만 추종술은 절정이다. 그의 밑에는 이런 사냥개들이 수두룩했다.

findings.correction: I let go of the collar of Hyuk Mujin, who had passed out for the third time, and offered an awkward smile.
findings.current: I let go of the collar of Hyuk Mujin, who had passed out for the third time, and gave him an awkward smile.
findings.defect: “Gave him” attaches the awkward smile to unconscious Hyuk Mujin. The smile is Taekyung’s awkward response to Gong Yacheong’s identification.
findings.rationale: 웃어 보였다 has no object. The beat is the identity reveal to Gong Yacheong after releasing Hyuk, not a smile aimed at Hyuk.
findings.source: 나는 세 번째로 기절한 혁무진의 멱살을 놓고 어색하게 웃어 보였다.

findings.correction: The ones chasing us aren’t ordinary martial artists. They’re wandering martial artists. They may be similar, but they’re entirely different creatures.
findings.current: The people chasing us aren’t martial artists. They’re wandering martial artists. They may be similar, but they’re entirely different creatures.
findings.defect: In English, wandering martial artists are martial artists, so the contrast collapses into a contradiction instead of 무인 versus 낭인 as similar but different kinds of being.
findings.rationale: Gong’s point is category, not a denial that the pursuers practice martial arts. The following hunting-dog gloss depends on that distinction remaining intelligible.
findings.source: 우리를 쫓는 건 무인이 아니라 낭인이오. 같지만 아주 다른 존재지.

findings.correction: A mysterious master—the first in a long while to catch his interest.
findings.current: At last, he was nearing the mysterious master who had caught his interest.
findings.defect: Adds “at last” and “nearing,” which were already covered by 곧 만날 수 있겠군. Drops 오랜만에: this mysterious master is the first to interest Jopil in a long time.
findings.rationale: 오랜만에 modifies 흥미를 끈, not the closing distance. The draft restates the previous thought and loses Jopil’s characterization.
findings.source: 오랜만에 그의 흥미를 끈 수수께끼의 고수다.

findings.defect: 헛 is a caught-out gasp, not swearing. The draft adds profanity the source does not have.
findings.rationale: Hyuk’s later “마, 맞습니다……” is the confession. 헛 is the startled leak before he admits it; intensifying it to “shit” changes register.

findings.correction: The martial prowess you displayed today was truly remarkable.
findings.current: The martial arts you displayed today were truly remarkable.
findings.defect: 무위 is displayed martial prowess, not 무공 (“martial arts”).
findings.rationale: Gong is judging demonstrated might against the rumors that Taekyung never trained, not naming a technique.
findings.source: 오늘 공자가 보여 준 무위는 실로 대단했소.

findings.correction: his black, viper-like eyes swept over the surroundings.
findings.current: his black eyes, cold as a venomous snake’s, swept over the surroundings.
findings.defect: The simile is black like a viper’s eyes. “Cold as” is added.
findings.rationale: 독사처럼 modifies 까만, the color and look of the pupils, not temperature or affect.

findings.correction: These days she was a creepy little sister, but when she was young she had been a baby angel.
findings.current: These days, she was an annoying little sister, but when she was young, she had been an angel.
findings.defect: 징그러운 is viscerally gross/creepy sibling disgust, weaker as “annoying.”
findings.rationale: The contrast is angelic child versus a sister who now makes his skin crawl, not mere annoyance. 아기 천사 is also slightly stronger than “an angel.”
findings.source: 지금이야 징그러운 여동생이지만 어릴 때는 아기 천사가 따로 없었다.

summary: One critical subject error assigns a subordinate’s Third Rate martial arts and Peak tracking to Jopil. Several major issues alter addressee, the 무인/낭인 contrast, Jopil’s interest, and a non-profane gasp.
